about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Suzan K. DelBene

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW-ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 261, UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 202
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW-ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 261, UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF...
sentences: Speaker Johnson and House Republicans are trying again to prevent our ability to have an up-or-down vote on Trump's tariffs, like they have done multiple times over the last year.
The President's chaotic trade war has been crushing businesses and raising prices on families across the country.
I am hearing from communities across Washington about the devastating impact of these tariffs.
I know my colleagues are hearing the same, especially from farmers who are often the first and hardest hit when countries retaliate against these tariffs.
Tariffs are taxes that raise prices, plain and simple.
These illegal tariffs cost the average American family $1,700 last year.
If my colleagues think these sweeping tariffs are such a good idea, then vote for it, but stop hiding.
I am grateful for my colleagues who have been fighting with me against these tariffs since the beginning.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
sentences: That is why during last week's markup on this bill, I introduced a responsible amendment that would have prohibited fraudulent centers from receiving TANF funds funded by taxpayer dollars.

This bill defines pregnancy centers as organizations that support ``protecting the life of the mother and the unborn child,'' but Republican's commitment to funneling taxpayer dollars to medical grifters endangers both.
I urge my colleagues to vote No on this irresponsible bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to express my unwavering support for this extension of the enhanced ACA tax credits.
Because of that, I will be voting in favor of this legislation and supporting the extension of the enhanced ACA tax credits.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to join me.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPACT OF EXPIRING TAX CREDITS
statements.title: IMPACT OF EXPIRING TAX CREDITS
sentences: Gerry has cancer and depends on his Affordable Care Act coverage to afford treatment.
Without the ACA tax credits, the same plan next year will cost him nearly $4,500 a month.
Mr. Speaker, I am going to keep fighting for Gerry and the millions of other Americans so that they can afford the coverage they need. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Healthcare premiums are skyrocketing because Republicans refuse to extend the ACA tax credits, causing healthcare costs to go up for everyone.
That is unacceptable for the wealthiest nation in the world.
I am going to keep fighting for affordable healthcare and lower costs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Republicans have spent months fighting over how many Americans they are going to kick off of Medicaid and how fast.
She raised two kids with the support of Medicaid, SNAP, and the child tax credit.
Mr. Speaker, I urge Republicans to listen to their constituents and vote ``no'' on this big, broken promise.
